name: arch-brief
title: 아키텍처 개요 — 한 장 요약
use: Draw a one-page build-structure overview (components, externals, design principles) on a finished arch-map result.
rules:
Target repo: in the request; read-only (no write, commit, checkout, build).
Needs the arch-map result (map.json + verify.json) of the repo's HEAD commit; run arch-map first when «준비» says it is missing.
Write only S/brief.json, S = the store dir printed by «준비» (same key/commit as arch-map). Never edit map.json, verify.json or flows.json.
Metadata only (module ids, names, file:line), never source text.
Language: all human text in map/flows/brief.json (not ids, paths, symbols) follows the request's Language line (none = English).

stages.title: 준비
stages.task: Run `/usr/bin/python3 scripts/arch_brief.py --pre --repo <repo>` once (from the Sidereus folder) and report its line verbatim. On a miss it says to run arch-map first; stop there and edit nothing.

stages.title: 개요 그리기
stages.task: Write S/brief.json only: {v:2, repo, commit, title<=60, what<=120, heads?:{arch,legend}<=40, actors:[{id,name<=30}] 1..2, screens:[{id,name<=40,note<=80,role<=100,modules:[ids] 1..}] 1..2, system:{name<=40, components:[{id,name<=40,note<=80,role<=100,modules:[ids] 1..} | {id,name<=40,note<=80,role<=100,pkgs:[{name<=24,note?<=40,modules:[ids] 1..}] 2..6}] 3..7 (<=1 with pkgs), principles:[{text<=100,evidence:{file,line}}] 2..4}, externals:[{id,name<=40,role<=100,uses:[{name<=30,note?<=40}] 1..3,modules:[ids] 1..}] 1..4, arrows:[{from,to,label<=32 required,use?:1..3,edges:[map edge index] 1..5}] <=12}. No other keys. Packages: one pkgs box. Stores (main DB too): externals. heads: plain nouns (Architecture), no sentences/legends. Arrows: what crosses on verify-ok edges; one per box pair; use on each into externals. No request sequence/route table. Human text: the request's Language line (none = English).

stages.title: 검증
stages.task: Run the gate once and report its printed line verbatim. It fails on unknown ids or keys; caps (3..7 components, <=1 with pkgs, 1..4 externals, 1..3 uses, 2..4 principles, <=12 arrows); a store/external map module outside externals; an arrow without label, with an unverified edge or one not joining its boxes, or with an actor endpoint; a use outside its external's uses; principle evidence missing or file:line absent at the commit; a v1 brief or v1 map («redraw as v2»). On pass it writes S/brief.html and S/brief.ok.json (sha256 of that html). Do not edit brief.json.
